generation.agentWorkspaceContract:
Build this as a complete, realistic multi-page or multi-route web application in the current directory with a real HTTP backend server and a seeded local data store so all user flows, forms, authentication, and state changes persist across page reloads.

Deployment contract (required):
1. Write `.bench-runtime.json` in the workspace root with JSON fields:
   {
     "buildCommand": "<production build command, or empty string if none>",
     "startCommand": "<command that starts the production server bound to 127.0.0.1 using the PORT environment variable>",
     "healthPath": "/"
   }
   (Alternatively, provide an executable `./start.sh` that honors `$PORT`.)
2. Run your build and verify your production server actually boots on a temporary free port and returns HTTP 200 on key routes and APIs before finishing.
3. Stop any test server processes you started before completing your turn.
generation.neutralSystemPrompt: Generate the complete, working source code for the requested website as one self-contained HTML document with all markup, styling, and scripts inline so no separate local asset files are required. Return only the code block without prose explanations outside the code block.
generation.visualReferenceInstruction: Use the attached reference layout image as a reference for the proposed page layout, visual hierarchy, color palette, and component styling while implementing all requested functionality.

modeDesignRationale.agent: Goal-oriented multi-turn autonomous coding loop inside a fresh empty directory with only the 4 core file/shell tools (read, bash, edit, write) and zero skills, extensions, MCP servers, or AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md context files. Builds a realistic multi-file application + real $PORT HTTP server.
modeDesignRationale.oneshot: Single-pass zero-tool completion returning one self-contained HTML document with inline styles and scripts, avoiding multi-file token truncation or broken local stylesheet/script links while keeping library and framework choices completely unsteered.

cleanRoomEnvironment.multimodalStyleProtocol: Prompts may optionally attach one or more visual reference images (`referenceImages`) to hold visual aesthetic complexity constant across models while keeping technology stack and performance completely unsteered.
